meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.citation: We expect fiscal third quarter sales to be in the range of $505-525 million and adjusted operating margin(2) in the range of 4.0-5.5%, reflecting a measured view of the macroeconomic backdrop, uneven consumer demand, and our continued near-term strategic investments and transitional costs as we optimize our plant footprint and progress our distribution and home delivery transformation.
